init_distributed_process_group: init a distributed process group using NCCL backend and a rendezvous file for multi-GPU training
average_metrics_across_ranks: average metrics across all distributed ranks using all_reduce to compute weighted mean values
wrap_model_ddp: wrap a PyTorch model with DistributedDataParallel for multi-GPU training with automatic device assignment
create_distributed_dataloader: create a distributed-aware DataLoader with DistributedSampler for training or manual sharding for evaluation
synchronize_distributed_ranks: synchronize all distributed ranks with a barrier call to ensure coordinated execution across processes
